answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond that is locked for a full epoch and tied to a continuous, verifiable activity pulse: real work, signed attestations, and uptime that cannot be faked in bulk. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so cost scales linearly with mesa-like breadth — no velvet shortcut lets one operator clone thousands cheaply. Honest agents recover their bond; fakes lose it when their pulse stops or fraud is proven.
